title: NodeJsInfo
description:
This defines the top-level object that describes the data returned by the server.
It contains information about each installation of Node.js that is known.

installations.description: The array of information about Posit Connect's Node.js installations.

enabled.description:
A `true` value is returned only when Node.js support is enabled in
Connect and Node.js content is permitted by the product license
(Advanced tier or Evaluation). It will be `false` in all other cases.

NodeJsInstallation.description: This defines the information provided by the server about a single installation of Node.js.

version.description: The version number of this Node.js installation.

cluster_name.description:
The cluster that contains this Node.js installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the Node.js installation is local to the
Posit Connect server.

image_name.description:
The image that contains this Node.js installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the Node.js installation is local to the
Posit Connect server.
